rule: A heatmap cell is stream-coverage eligible iff at least one of contracts.call or contracts.put is a real contract identity. NO CONTRACT cells stay labelled and are excluded from the denominator. ZERO OI cells are real contracts and remain included.
mirror_reason: Visible Auto/Wider/All scope is decided only on the client. Production cells carry the server stamp; unstamped fixtures and DOM filtering apply the same predicate. The mirror is locked by tests/test_gamma_stream_coverage_eligibility_v1.py.
